applies_to: Honeywell Midas S2 single-point extractive gas transmitters with Ethernet/PoE, user manual 3023M5001 Rev A, Modbus/TCP register map (Table 6-1).
summary: The Midas S2 is a Honeywell pumped single-point gas transmitter for toxic, flammable and oxygen gases. Its Ethernet port is a Modbus/TCP server: holding registers 40001-40122 give a packed status word, the gas reading, decimal point and units, temperature, cell life, flow, alarm and fault flags. This map covers the 16-bit registers; float, time and text registers are left out.

addressing.note: The table lists reference addresses 40001-40122 (Modicon style), so 40001 (status) is wire address 0 and 40005 (gas reading) is wire address 4.

source.title: Midas S2 Fixed single-point extractive gas transmitter User Manual

notes: Left out: float registers (concentration 40003-40004, alarm thresholds 40013-40016, high scale 40019-40020). The manual only says floats are "little-endian or Intel format", which does not pin down the word order on the wire.
Left out: 32-bit UNIX time registers 40061-40062, 40065-40068 (word order not stated) and the ASCII serial-number and gas-name registers (character order within a register not stated).

Left out: user command registers 40021-40022 (CMD1 0x015E-0x0B5E with CMD2 0x3626 for reset, inhibit and relay control): the manual says only function 03 is supported, so how they are written is unclear.

Status register 40001 packs numbers: bits 0-3 monitoring state (0 warm-up, 1 monitor, 2 alarms inhibited, 3 alarms and faults inhibited, 4 fully inhibited, 5 alarm/fault simulation, 6 bump test, 7 4-20 mA calibration, 8 other calibration); bits 4-5 fault state (0 none, 1 maintenance fault, 2 instrument fault).
The manual mentions an older 40082 duplicate in the sensor serial list (typo for 40092); text registers are excluded anyway.
Only function 03 (read holding registers) is supported.
The manual does not state the TCP port; Modbus/TCP normally uses 502.

registers.name: Status (STTS)
registers.description: Bits 0-3 monitoring state, bits 4-5 fault state; flags below.

registers.name: Gas selection (GASS)
registers.description: Low byte gas ID, high byte cartridge type.

registers.name: Gas concentration integer (CONC)
registers.description: Divide by 10^decimal (40007 bits 0-2); ppm for ppm/ppb gases.

registers.name: Most important active fault number (NOFT)
registers.description: Fault code; see the troubleshooting table in the manual.

registers.name: Decimal point and units (DPUN)
registers.description: Bits 0-2 decimals; high byte units: 1 ppm, 2 ppb, 4 %vol, 8 %LEL, 16 mA.

registers.name: Heartbeat counter (HRTB)
registers.description: Low 16 bits of time in seconds.

registers.name: Transmitter serial number prefix
registers.description: First four digits of the S-number as a decimal value.

registers.name: Transmitter serial number suffix
registers.description: Last digits of the S-number as a decimal value.

integration.summary: Connect to the Midas S2 IP and read holding registers 0-17 with function 03; gas = 40005 / 10^(40007 bits 0-2).
integration.enable: Modbus/TCP is part of the Ethernet interface; set the network address in the transmitter setup.
quirks: Gas reading is in ppm for ppm and ppb gases, otherwise in display units.
In bump test mode the Modbus outputs are not inhibited.
setup: Modbus TCP has no authentication; isolate it on a secure network.
Factory default IP address is 192.168.0.14; without DHCP, put the PC on the same subnet.
gotchas: Read 40007 together with 40005 to apply the right decimal point.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
